gloss: either is fine; whichever; I don't mind either way

definitions.gloss: either is fine; whichever; I don't care which
definitions.explanation: Casual version of どちらでもいい. The speaker has no preference between two options. Tone ranges from genuinely easy-going to annoyed (couldn't care less), depending on delivery.

examples.japanese: コーヒーか{紅茶|こうちゃ}か、どっちでもいいから{早|はや}く{決|き}めて。
examples.english: Coffee or tea, either one — just decide quickly.

examples.japanese: {結果|けっか}がどうなるかなんて、{今|いま}は{正直|しょうじき}どっちでもいい{気分|きぶん}だ。
examples.english: Honestly, right now I don't really care either way how it turns out.

notes:
Casual contraction of どちらでもいい. The どっち is informal; the でもいい frame is the standard 'X is fine' permission/indifference structure.

REGISTER:
- Casual; in polite speech use どちらでもいいです or どちらでも{結構|けっこう}です
- Tone matters: said warmly, it's accommodating; said curtly, it sounds dismissive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- どちらでもいい: standard, polite-neutral form
- どっちでも{構|かま}わない: 'either is fine' — slightly more emphatic, often masculine
- なんでもいい: anything is fine — when the choice space is open (not just two)
- お{任|まか}せします: 'I leave it to you' — defers to the other person rather than expressing indifference
